title: campanula atlantica
intro: Campanula atlantica, commonly known as the Atlantic bellflower or mountain bellflower, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the Campanulaceae family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving respiratory health due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Campanula atlantica include its ability to calm the nervous system and promote relaxation, making it a natural remedy for anxiety and stress relief. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, glycosides, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
